title: Night sky suddenly bright in the Brookhaven incident
summary: unidentified clip speaker tells of Night sky suddenly bright in the Brookhaven incident, about 1992 (November) at Brookhaven, Long Island, New York, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: It's about 7:00 at night and being November, it was full dark and all of a sudden it was lighter out than it is right now.

plain: An unnamed witness, heard in a clip on a podcast, says that one November evening in 1992 in Brookhaven, on Long Island in New York, it was about seven o'clock and fully dark. Then, the witness says, all of a sudden it became lighter outside than daytime. It is told as part of a wider event in that area, a sign that something unexplained lit up the sky.
